subject: Renewal + capacity uplift — procurement portal & onboarding steps
messages:
From: Susan Kelly <susan.kelly@nexam ed.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nexam ed.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + uplift — NexaMed needs onboarding + PO questions

Hi Jonas,

Hope you’re well — we’re kicking off our renewal with Redwood and looking to increase committed capacity by ~30% for H1 next year. Legal asked that we go through your procurement portal again for vendor re-onboarding (we last did this in 2024). Two quick asks so we can lock timing:

1) Can you confirm the procurement portal steps and who from Redwood needs to approve the PO?
2) We’ve attached a draft PO template (NexaMed_PO_Draft.docx) — is that acceptable or do you need a Redwood PO?

We’re targeting countersign by the end of next week if possible. Can you share a short checklist of required artifacts so we can prep with our procurement team?

Thanks,
Susan Kelly
Director, Procurement — NexaMed
procurement@nexam ed.com
Attachment: NexaMed_PO_Draft.docx (docx)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Susan Kelly <susan.kelly@nexam ed.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, avery_johnson@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + uplift — NexaMed needs onboarding + PO questions

Hi Susan — great to hear and thanks for the heads up. We can definitely support a 30% uplift; happy to align timelines so procurement can get what they need quickly. Short answer to your asks below, and I’ve pasted a concise checklist and proposed timeline.

Quick answers:
- Procurement portal: we will trigger a vendor re-onboarding invite (email-based). Approvals required: Procurement (you), Redwood Finance (PO intake), Redwood Legal (SOW/terms) — final countersign from Redwood RevOps.
- PO: the NexaMed_PO_Draft.docx is fine — we normally accept customer PO templates; Finance will validate invoice fields. If you need Redwood-issued PO, we can raise one after countersign.

Required artifacts checklist (we’ll upload to the portal once you accept):
- Completed procurement portal form (company details + tax id)
- W-9 or equivalent (if required by your AP)
- Latest SOC 2 attestation (we’ll include a pointer)
- Signed SOW (we can accept redlines; gap review by Legal)
- Final PO or PO number

Proposed timeline:
- Wed Nov 4: I’ll send the portal invite + procurement-checklist.xlsx (attached)
- Thu Nov 5: internal review of SOW redlines by Redwood Legal (laura_bennett)
- Mon Nov 9: countersign / DocuSign link if all good

I looped Marissa (Customer Success) for the rollout plan and Avery (Ops) for any entitlement mapping in the portal. If that timeline is tight for your AP team, tell me what date we should aim for and we’ll accelerate.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
Attachment: procurement-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks Jonas — I’ll draft a mutual action plan (MAP) to capture milestones and the enablement steps for the 30% uplift. High level I’ll include: rollout window, migration of contracts to the dedicated commit (if they choose), and a short success checklist for the first 30 days post-go-live.

Susan — once you accept the portal invite we’ll set a 30-minute sync to walk AP through fields and confirm the PO line items that map to usage buckets.

—Marissa
